answer: An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch therefore burns the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Because the ridge solution is checked at the ivory gate and logged, the quill audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 17 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Each copy needs 6 hours of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
